The individual colors are painted into each cutout, with a near-white light center and calm colored edges, ready for display without runtime tinting.
These will appear about 20 to 26 screen pixels wide: prioritize clean readable four-tip shape, a bright focal center and two or three broad material strokes over tiny detail. Preserve painted antialiasing and actual transparency. No extra satellite flecks, glows extending across cells, trails, frames, labels, letters, grid lines, background, floor, checkerboard, cast shadows, characters, objects, five-point stars, circles, hard vector polygons, 3D, photorealism or white sticker rims.
